description: User-chosen escape hatch for unreadable clothing/body geometry: complete the workout without fabricated camera credit.
oracle: No automatic fallback. After explicit choice, absent frames and visible synthetic cycles produce no measured hold, reps or scores. Only Finish this set advances. The next movement returns to camera assessment. Debrief distinguishes unassessed completion from a skip.
coverageGaps: Synthetic UI/software coverage, not real clothing or body-size validation. The existing camera preview must already have opened; this is not a camera-permission bypass.
